message:
Thanks, Donna: the somewhat revised version -- I'm still tweaking it -- is [here](http://vitia.org/paris.html). Tonight's been a bit of a long night: nothing like having your computer break the night before your Computers & Writing presentation. Feeling frustrated and frazzled, but I'm thinking that my co-presenter and I have enough going on in common in our presentations that I might ask her about combining them into something for Kairos.

I'll be glad when tomorrow's done.
